data.current_description: This endpoint creates a callback state that can be used to issue requests to the callback endpoint.
data.summary_suggestion: Create callback state for OAuth redirect flow
data.description_suggestion: Creates a callback state token used to secure OAuth redirect flows during connection authentication.
